provenance.claim_this_file_makes: None yet. The shape is committed; the numbers are not, and this file says so rather than carrying an invented threshold that looks like evidence.
provenance.how_to_measure: MAINLINE_TEST_DSN=postgresql://root@127.0.0.1:26257/defaultdb?sslmode=disable python -m pytest tests/integration/recall_index/test_ix06_ingest_degradation.py -m nightly -s   (or leave MAINLINE_TEST_DSN unset and put `cockroach` on PATH, or start the Docker daemon)
what_gets_measured: live: row-at-a-time and small-batch INSERT straight into mainline.event_cue_embedding, which carries the C-SPANN index and the projection trigger. This is the production path and the loader's batch size must come from THIS curve's knee.

staged: bulk INSERT into mainline.event_cue_stage, which carries no vector index, followed by keyset-paginated promotion. Promotion is an INSERT into the live table, so every promoted row passes the same projection trigger; staging is a performance path, not a hole in the weld.

import_then_index: the REJECTED fallback. CREATE VECTOR INDEX on a populated table. Measured so that the decision not to use it has a price tag rather than only a reason. It is the one path into the prefixed sidecar that does not pass through the projection trigger.
provenance.why_this_file_exists: CockroachDB's documented guidance is that large batch inserts of VECTOR types can cause performance degradation and that batching should be avoided. That is a direction, not a number. A build that picks a batch size from that sentence has invented a threshold. This artefact replaces the invented number with a measured one, on the cluster the corpus is actually going into.
provenance.unmeasured_because: No CockroachDB cluster was reachable on the machine this was authored on: no `cockroach` binary on PATH and no running Docker daemon. Nothing in this domain may be claimed on the basis of a skipped run, so the file records the absence instead of a plausible-looking guess.
provenance.note_on_the_corpus_builder: tests/integration/recall_index/_support.py:CORPUS_BATCH is currently 100 and is labelled a conservative guess. It is the FIRST thing that should be re-set from the `live` knee once this file carries numbers.
